name: Target Corporation
reason: Mass-merchant losing share to Walmart/Amazon: EPS 0.56x 10y peak, 5y EPS CAGR -4.3% and EBIT margin 4.6% near 10y low - cheap but no widening moat.

name: Thor Industries
reason: RV maker with deeply cyclical discretionary demand: EPS fell from $20.59 (FY22) to $3.38 (0.16x peak), margin 2.7%, and growth driven by acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.63).

name: Timken Company
reason: Cyclical industrial bearings with 10y ROIC only 8.9%, growth bought via M&A (acq/FCF 0.88) and EPS down two straight years to 0.76x peak - good but not special.

name: Tutor Perini Corporation
reason: Fixed-price construction contractor with losses in 2022-24, 10y avg ROIC -1.4% and FCF inflated by claims/advance collections rather than recurring earnings.

name: Trulieve Cannabis
reason: Cannabis operator with GAAP losses 2022-25, binary federal/state regulatory outcomes and 107x NTM P/E; FCF yield partly reflects unpaid 280E tax accruals.

name: Tractor Supply Company
reason: Rural-lifestyle retail leader with 10y EPS CAGR 13.1%, steady ~10% EBIT margin (27th pctile, not peaked), 10y ROIC ~20% and needs-based consumables/pet mix plus store-count runway; recent EPS growth slowed to ~1%/yr so the 7% route needs confirming.

name: The Trade Desk
reason: Independent ad-tech DSP whose EPS fell 46% in 2025 amid Amazon DSP competition and AI/walled-garden disintermediation risk; adj-vs-GAAP gap ~294% from stock comp.

name: TETRA Technologies
reason: Oilfield completion fluids/brine chemicals tied to drilling activity; EBIT margin at 10y high (9.4%) after years of losses, 10y ROIC -0.7% and shares up 5.5%/yr.

name: Uber Technologies
reason: Only three profitable years (EBIT margin 11.9% at its 10y high) and a credible 5-year autonomous-vehicle threat to the driver-network model make long-range EPS unforecastable.

name: UDR, Inc.
reason: Coastal/Sunbelt apartment REIT with FFO/share CAGR 4.3% over 10y, net debt/EBITDA 5.95x and no route to 7% growth - ordinary rate-sensitive real estate.

name: Frontier Group Holdings
reason: Ultra-low-cost airline with negative EBIT margin (-12.1%), fuel and capacity-driven earnings and shares outstanding up sharply since IPO; FCF yield is not recurring.

name: UnitedHealth Group
reason: Scale leader but EPS collapsed 41% in 2025 on Medicare Advantage cost trend and reimbursement/regulatory and DOJ scrutiny, so the 5-10y earnings path depends on government policy.

name: UroGen Pharma
reason: Single-asset urothelial-cancer biotech with operating losses every year (EBIT margin -114%) and shares up ~15%/yr; consensus EPS is speculative.

name: USA Compression Partners
reason: Gas-compression MLP tied to energy activity with net debt/EBITDA 4.2x, units growing 9.7%/yr, acquisition-funded growth (acq/FCF 1.15) and margin at 10y high.

name: U.S. Physical Therapy
reason: Roll-up of PT clinics (acq/FCF 0.9) facing Medicare fee-schedule cuts; EBIT margin fell from ~14% to 10.5%, 10y ROIC 6.6% and EPS CAGR only 3.9%.

name: United Therapeutics
reason: Highly profitable PAH franchise (EBIT margin ~48%) but EPS at 10y high is concentrated in Tyvaso/Remodulin facing generic/Yutrepia competition and binary pipeline/organ-manufacturing bets.

name: Veeco Instruments
reason: Cyclical semicap equipment niche player with 10y avg ROIC -4.8%, shares up 4.3%/yr and EPS down 24% in 2025; no durable moat.

name: Valmont Industries
reason: Strong record (9/10 years of EPS growth) but EPS at 1.0x 10y max and margin in 91st pctile at the top of a utility-grid capex upcycle, with ag-irrigation and steel-cost cyclicality and only ~9% avg ROIC.

name: Vivmark Residential
reason: Large apartment REIT with FFO/share CAGR only 1.4% over 10y and net debt/EBITDA 4.45x - stable but no path to 7% growth and no specialness.

name: Vornado Realty Trust
reason: NYC office REIT with FFO/share falling 5.9%/yr, net debt/EBITDA 9.6x and structural office-demand risk; 20% FCF yield is not a reason to own it.
